p-petsalon.notes:
Noticed their detail page images were decent especially the half dirty  half clean side by side with a thin line down the middle could use them as reference later.

Loading screen with bubbles for 10 sec, cut scene with no skip of a stinky muddy cat appearing in a box that you open and clean the cat, and then realize can make money at your salon (missed some indoor here) but was dialog and images of you imagining a salon

Then teleports you to a station with an arrow pointing at your station and one at the clean it button with dialog on the bottom their ui popups look clean maybe we should copy later.

Then brings you to an animal that is dirty on a table showing with a mouse hand and movement what to do on how to do it with text on top saying step 1 of 3. Foam up has pop ups like Awesome, Excellent,unstoppable, so sleek while showing like 5x/12x,18x as your doing steps, then trim fluff, same action all 3 times is a little boring nust swiping side to side, after first one has a cutscene of evil people on how they will make money or something kinda missed it, it had a small button to hold in top right to skip.

the usual flowing transparent arrows but green on where to go with a green bobbing arrow pointed at the end goal of where to walk.

Looks like sometimes the cleaning has to click on things to knock it off and gives a star ratings with a money/xp breakdown after each clean thats kinda cool, lets you hire people to take customers that come with animals also to help you and you can either click on customer with a pet waiting or your table to next pet kinda lame that only one customer comes at a time

They have rare customers “influencers” for this game that can come with rare pets like pandas and they have like 16 grooming steps instead of the 3-6 I normally saw and when done they give permanent money or xp boosts and lots of money. The star recap/breakdown of money and xp you got for the clean is a neat idea. The 16 steps felt a little long but they made it so you can upgrade your tools and stuff like blow dryers etc to be better slightly each upgrade they also had an index. the animal rotated the whole time sometimes annoying if you miss spots some steps included scrubbing (swiping), washing (aiming the water), pulling stuff from fur (picking it and moving it off cat), trimming nails (holding on areas), lots of ideas to do for variation.

(I am possibly leaning towards more of you can do the spa cleaning but also hire helpers to take customers but they are much slower and have more customers show up so you can pick who to take next etc.. maybe make customers who wait too long get impatient and leave just throwing ideas).
